data.long_meaning: The name Fayroz is derived from the Arabic word 'firaza' which means 'to be victorious'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes strength, determination, and the ability to overcome challenges. The name Fayroz carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Fayroz usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
